upcoming_events.title: Seeing Red Wine Festival
upcoming_events.description: Four days in Seaside: the Bud & Alley's vintners dinner Thursday, the Al Fresco Reserve Tasting on the Lyceum lawn Friday evening, Saturday's Battle of the Sommeliers and Grand Tasting across Central Square and Ruskin Place, and a Celebration of Bubbles brunch Sunday morning · benefits DCWAF · tickets at seasideseeingred.com · 5-min walk or drive.

upcoming_events.title: WaterColor Mountainfilm on Tour
upcoming_events.description: Two nights of award-winning documentary shorts on adventure, environment and culture, straight from the Mountainfilm festival in Telluride, outdoors at the Marina Park Amphitheater · gates 5:45 PM, films at 7 PM · 10-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Baytowne Tribute Weekend
upcoming_events.description: Two free nights of tribute bands on the Events Plaza Lawn, 7–9 PM — Pandora's Box Friday, The 77 Experience Saturday · bring a blanket or lawn chairs · 25-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Alys Beach Crafted
upcoming_events.description: Five days of craft and culinary events — a songwriters session at Caliza, experiential dinners, the Firkin Fête, the Spirited Soirée cocktail tasting, and the Holiday Makers Market each afternoon · benefits the Cultural Arts Alliance of Walton County · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Rosemary Beach Uncorked
upcoming_events.description: 15th annual · Saturday Nov 14, 2026, 1–4 PM · wines poured by vintners from around the world alongside dishes from ten Rosemary Beach restaurants, with live music as you stroll the cobblestone streets · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: 30A 10K Thanksgiving Day Races
upcoming_events.description: Thanksgiving-morning 10K, 5K and 1-mile fun run through Rosemary Beach, with the 10K stepping off around 7:30 AM · Highway 30A closes to traffic 7–10:30 AM for the course · advance registration only, no race-day sign-up · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Turn On The Town
upcoming_events.description: Saturday Nov 28, 2026 — the holiday parade steps off from Seagrove Plaza at 3 PM and ends in Central Square, where Santa lights the town tree at 5 PM in the Amphitheater · free to attend · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: 30A Songwriters Festival
upcoming_events.description: 18th annual · MLK weekend · songwriters across 30A's intimate listening rooms in Seaside, Rosemary, Alys, WaterColor, Grayton and more · benefits the Cultural Arts Alliance · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seaside Farmers Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sat 9–1 · Saturdays year-round, 9 AM–1 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater, with a second Tuesday market added each June and July · local growers, artisan cheeses and breads, craft chefs, and live acoustic music · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: 30A Farmers' Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sun 9–1 · About 30 vendors on Barrett Square every Sunday, 9 AM–1 PM — local produce and micro-greens, Gulf seafood off the boat, artisan breads and sweets, grass-fed beef, tupelo honey · pet-friendly · a great Sunday-morning outing · 15-min drive east

copy.instagram:
Four nights open across both cottages: Thu Nov 5 – Sun 8.

Six bedrooms, four baths, sixteen guests — side by side on the same quiet lane, one address.

Nobody drives across town for breakfast. Nobody misses the walk over for sunset.

Book direct, link in bio.
copy.facebook: Golden Sun and Blue Moon are both open Thu Nov 5 – Sun 8, four nights — that's six bedrooms, four baths and room for sixteen at one address on Crystal Court, with the public Pelayo beach access a 3-minute walk straight across Scenic 30A. Live availability and real prices at https://book.sunandmoon30a.com
